content:
No templates found with those criteria. Maybe the template is not filtered by functional groups; we can search without criteria just by molecule. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with only molecule_smiles and limit higher.


<thought>Search the template catalog for any templates applicable to the product molecule without functional group filters, to retrieve the template that generated the given precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(C(=O)NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N)c1",
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
